A crash on StopIteration would be unhandled but the plan step specifies this logic. I think this is acceptable per the plan; the verifier's job is to check against the ticket and plan. 4. `set_status(dup_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)` — set_status persists via save_households. Correct.

One more check: does the script handle the case where the kept record is also... no.
